findings.oracle: On Windows, intercepts kernel32.OpenProcess via setattr spy, calls _get_cached_process_handle(WIN_PROCESS_VM_READ) on a bridge attached to os.getpid(), asserts every recorded bInheritHandle is exactly False; gates break if the inline is changed back to a truthy constant
Source-text regex check provides no behavioral gate; the real gate is test_open_process_called_with_inherit_handle_false which verifies the runtime argument, not a string search
Type annotation check via inspect.signature is tautological and does not gate runtime behavior; test_raises_when_not_attached already covers the behavioral contract
Static constant membership check is already covered by test_unknown_check_recorded_as_error and test_mixed_known_and_unknown_partial_success which exercise the actual rejection dispatch logic

After set_va_base(0, 0x400000, 0x200) returns True, asserts list_va_mappings() contains exactly {file_offset:0, virtual_address:0x400000, length:0x200}; gates break if set_va_base returns True without persisting the mapping

PE fixture has PE_FULL_IMAGE_BASE=0x400000 with .text at VirtualAddress=0x1000 and .data at 0x2000; asserts exactly 3 mappings with VAs {0x400000, 0x401000, 0x402000} and file_offsets {0, 0x200, 0x400} independently derived from conftest constants

ELF fixture has PT_LOAD1 p_vaddr=0x400000/p_offset=0x1000/p_filesz=0x200 and PT_LOAD2 p_vaddr=0x401000/p_offset=0x2000/p_filesz=0x100; asserts both VA and offset values exactly, gates break if VA calculation is wrong or reversed
